__comment: Hops plant — surface-only annual bine, primary bittering agent for ales and stouts.
Must be grown on designated surface dirt farm plots with open sky.
Annual crop: after harvest the farm plot returns to FALLOW. Dwarves must re-seed from cuttings.
Three growth stages: seedling → climbing → mature.
Mature stage has two seasonal models (summer full-leaf, autumn yellow-dry).
Only the mature stage yields a harvest; earlier stages yield nothing.
Winter: growth is dormant (WorldClock rate ×0.0) — seedlings and climbing plants
freeze in place and resume in spring. The mature stage cannot be reached in winter;
any plant that was not harvested before winter sets in is lost at season change.
